notAllowed: You can't make this change. Refresh the case to see the actions available to you.
conflict: Someone else changed this case. Refresh it and check the latest details before trying again.

reply.personHint: Only the person you choose receives this reply.

note.title: Internal note
note.bodyHint: Only staff can see this note. Write up to 4,000 characters.
note.bodyTooLong: Keep the note to 4,000 characters or fewer.

status.label: New status
status.hint: These are the status changes available for this case.

resolve.description: Record the outcome and explain it to the people on this case.
resolve.resolutionHint: Choose one of the available outcomes.
resolve.summaryHint: Shown to the people on the case. Write 10–1,000 characters.
resolve.summaryTooShort: Explain the resolution in at least 10 characters.
resolve.summaryTooLong: Keep the summary to 1,000 characters or fewer.

resolve.settleInvalid: Enter a valid price below the agreed {price}.
resolve.goodwillHint: Enter the amount to refund the client from platform funds.

resolve.sentForApproval: Sent for approval. A different finance or admin approves the refund on the booking; the case stays open until then.
resolve.contactDescription: Record the outcome. Nobody on this case is signed in, so email your answer before you resolve it.
resolve.contactSummaryHint: For staff only: this case has no one to show it to. Write 10–1,000 characters.

details.emptyTimeline: No updates yet. Replies, notes and changes will appear here.

review.title: Reported review
review.whoCan: Support leads, trust and safety, and admins can hide a review.

dialog.hideDescription: It comes off {name}'s profile and out of their rating. The reason goes in the audit log and on this case.
dialog.showDescription: It goes back on {name}'s profile and into their rating. The reason goes in the audit log and on this case.
dialog.hint: 10 to 1,000 characters, for example which guideline it breaks.
dialog.required: Enter a reason of at least 10 characters.
dialog.notAllowed: You can't change this review. Ask a support lead or trust and safety.

savedReplies.label: Start from a saved reply
savedReplies.hint: It replaces what you wrote; {firstName} and {staffName} are filled in when you send it.

emailContact.title: Answer by email
emailContact.warning: This may not be the account's owner: anyone can type an address into the contact form. Don't include account details (bookings, payments, addresses or verification), even if an account uses this address. For account questions, ask them to sign in and contact support from their account.
emailContact.bodyHint: Up to 4,000 characters. Sent in {language} and signed with your first name. Replies to it don’t reach us: they write back through the contact form.
emailContact.bodyTooLong: Keep the email to 4,000 characters or fewer.

question.whatHideDoes: Hiding or removing it takes the question and its answer off the task for members. Staff still see them, marked.
question.whatRestoreDoes: Restoring it puts the question and its answer back on the task for members.

dialog.hideDescription: The question and its answer leave the task for members. The reason goes in the audit log and on this case.
dialog.removeDescription: Like hiding, for content that breaks the rules outright. The reason goes in the audit log and on this case.
dialog.restoreDescription: The question and its answer go back on the task for members. The reason goes in the audit log and on this case.
dialog.hint: 5 to 500 characters, for example which guideline it breaks.
dialog.required: Enter a reason of at least 5 characters.
dialog.notAllowed: This case isn't about a question.
dialog.newerOpen: This helper has a newer open question on the task. Hide or remove that one first, then restore this one.

question.whoCan: Trust and safety, support leads and admins can hide, remove or restore a question.

thanks.title: Reported thank-you note
thanks.nameHidden: The client asked not to show their name on the profile.
thanks.whoCan: Support leads, trust and safety and admins can hide it.

dialog.hideDescription: It leaves {name}'s profile, and {name} no longer sees its words. The client can still delete it.
dialog.showDescription: It goes back on {name}'s profile if {name} chose to show it.
dialog.hint: Kept in the audit log and as an internal note on this case (10 to 1,000 characters).
dialog.required: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.
